task.description: dado-core depends on miter-engine and miter-ast, yet splice/ast_check.rs builds its own tree-sitter parser with tree-sitter, tree-sitter-rust and tree-sitter-typescript (three C-compiled crates) to validate spliced code. miter-engine already exposes the shared parser (polyglot::dispatch::{parse,parse_detected,parse_declarative}); dado's copy covers fewer languages (validate_syntax errors with 'Python grammar not yet enabled in dado' for Language::Python even though miter parses Python). Replacing validate_syntax with the miter-engine parser removes three C dependencies from dado's build graph and closes the Python gap. Note: dado-core/src/polyglot/{rust_gen,ts_gen}.rs is code GENERATION, not extraction, so it is not duplication and should stay with dado.
task.title: dado-core re-implements tree-sitter syntax validation instead of using miter-engine's polyglot parser

receipt.summary: Closed across two repositories, each on its own branch with the lease taken before any edit (miter feat/miter-syntax-diagnostics, dado feat/dado-use-miter-parser). miter main 4fc2cb5 adds polyglot::syntax: one parser_for constructor shared with dispatch::parse, syntax_diagnostics returning positioned ERROR and MISSING nodes, span_within_node for hole boundaries, and character-boundary slicing so a multi-byte span cannot panic; six tests, gate 238/238. dado main 2d7fc54 turns validate_syntax and check_hole_boundary into thin adapters over that API, drops three direct tree-sitter dependencies, and formats the established message shapes; five tests cover Python validating (previously refused), broken Python reporting a position, unchanged Rust shape, a declarative format, and boundaries; gate 14/14. miter-engine's crate version is deliberately unchanged - local development resolves it through the harness [patch.crates-io] and the bump belongs with the next release.
